title: SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: 60 regular Non-Teaching & Para-Medical posts including Staff Nurse (~25), Clerk, Ayurvedic Pharmacist and other posts as per Advt NT-01/2026 to 03/2026
qualification: Post-wise: Staff Nurse – GNM/B.Sc Nursing with registration; Clerk / Pharmacist / other posts as per SKAU detailed advertisement
ageLimit: 18 to 42 years as on 21 Aug 2026 (relaxations as per Haryana Govt rules)
applicationFee: Male General/Other State ₹1500 | Female General (Haryana domicile) ₹750 | Haryana Reserve Category ₹375 | PH – Exempted
selectionProcess: Written Exam / Screening as per post → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate, Haryana domicile / PPP where required, registration certificate for nursing/pharmacy posts
howToApply:
1. Visit https://recruitment.skau.ac.in/nonteaching/
2. Register using mobile / PPP as instructed
3. Fill non-teaching application form
4. Upload documents and pay fee
5. Submit by 21 August 2026 and print confirmation
shortDescription: SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Online Form 2026 for 60 posts (Staff Nurse, Clerk, Pharmacist & more). Apply 30 July–21 August 2026 at recruitment.skau.ac.in.
content:
Shri Krishna AYUSH University (SKAU), Kurukshetra has invited online applications for 60 regular Non-Teaching / Para-Medical posts under Advt. Nos. NT-01/2026 to 03/2026.

Application window: 30 July 2026 to 21 August 2026.

Indicative posts

  • Staff Nurse
  • Clerk and related office posts
  • Ayurvedic Pharmacist / other para-medical posts

Apply only through the official portal recruitment.skau.ac.in/nonteaching. Check post-wise qualification, fee and age in the detailed PDF on skau.ac.in before applying.
